import ctypes
import os

def load_gsl_libraries():
    # Load the libraries in the correct order
    libgslcblas = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    libgsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")
    return libgsl

def gsl_cdf_weibull(x, a, b):
    # Load the GSL library
    libgsl = load_gsl_libraries()

    # Define the argument and return types for gsl_cdf_weibull_P
    libgsl.gsl_cdf_weibull_P.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
    libgsl.gsl_cdf_weibull_P.restype = ctypes.c_double

    # Define the argument and return types for gsl_cdf_weibull_Q
    libgsl.gsl_cdf_weibull_Q.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
    libgsl.gsl_cdf_weibull_Q.restype = ctypes.c_double

    # Call the C functions
    P = libgsl.gsl_cdf_weibull_P(x, a, b)
    Q = libgsl.gsl_cdf_weibull_Q(x, a, b)

    return P, Q
